categoryNote: Reuse/crop rows identify whether their source exists today or is a planned master. A planned source is not an existing file. Unique marks one anchor per new master, not every panel dependent on new art.

globalSpecification.style: Original classic 1980s–1990s cel-anime characters in painterly cinematic cyberpunk environments; accepted ink/paper/coral/cyan interface palette. Illustrations support dramatic action without UI baked into art.
globalSpecification.delivery: Landscape 16:9 local WebP. Prefer 2560×1440 master if the chosen method supports it; 1280×720 is acceptable with looser crops. No paid upscaling assumed. Keep source master and provenance/rights receipt. No asset may be activated just because a specification exists.
globalSpecification.cropGate: Crop is a spatial subset, never new pose/expression/time. No mirroring, repainting or multi-time montage. Review native pixel dimensions and bilingual desktop/mobile framing before activation. If a required ROI is too small, loosen the detail or keep text-led rather than enlarge blindly.
globalSpecification.continuity: Approved EN/zh-TW screenplay v0.2 and canon prevail. No extra dialogue, casualties, fates, moral ranking or other-timeline knowledge. Existing references are provisional with undocumented rights.
globalSpecification.overlay: All bilingual dialogue and UI remain HTML below art. No baked lettering. Reserve quiet lower-right for the localized provisional art caption; check contrast manually.

Preserve the accepted left-side ascent crop; the right-hand ring must remain excluded.

A muted civic gathering, separate from A’s protest, supports this route’s honors and private loss.
Alex beside Jacque’s grave is a new private grief scene; no reuse for routes where Jacque survives.
The same Alex-only stair geometry works after rescue; keep Jacque entirely off-frame.
The city boundary is a common outcome; no route-specific people in the master.
Jacque alive, injured and trying to rise needs a safe Downtown ambulance composition.
Preserve the accepted ascent crop excluding the ring; it depicts the route before activation.
The same unobservable erasure endpoint can serve F; never depict Alex alive inside the white volume.
Jacque in the open ambulance, radio and gaze detail supports this aftermath without inventing a new location.
The original hospital handholding fits this explicit intimate reconciliation beat.
A city insert expresses Downtown spared; it is narrator geography, not a literal hospital-window viewpoint.
Days-later intimacy on the roof is emotionally distinct from H’s isolated search before activation.
Hands/faces hold the final admission and guilt; no changed expression or invented happier resolution.
The face closing as Alex leaves the ward is a dramatic rupture; the handholding source contradicts it.
Alex searching alone on a rooftop before activation needs a cold, isolated composition.
The same city boundary closes the search; avoid adding an observer who sees other timelines.
Official reconstruction and conflicting duties need a new institutional scene, not another battle image.
Maps and officials sustain the inquiry; the headline remains localized HTML rather than baked text.

A neutral medical entrance and physical separation can support the later encounter; no romantic handhold.
